## Slide 3 — 1. Engineering Background (REQUIRED; enabled)

Scientific guardrail: Do not portray charging-load effect as V2G reverse energy flow or as a verified heat-conditioned thermal interdependency.

**Click 1 — `S03_C01_P_SYSTEM`**
- Reveal: Power System enclosure and its relevant equipment/function labels
- Why: Introduce Power as a distinct system boundary; no selected device or operating limit is asserted.
- Status: THESIS-DEFINED; source basis: Canonical Electrified Transportation Scope Definition V1

**Click 2 — `S03_C02_FULL_TE`**
- Reveal: Full Electrified Transportation System enclosure and membership: vehicle, RESS, propulsion, auxiliaries, supply circuit, EVSE, physical connection, communication and control
- Why: Present full Tₑ—not EVSE alone—and show both systems without merger.
- Status: THESIS-DEFINED; source basis: Canonical Electrified Transportation Scope Definition V1 §§1–4A

**Click 3 — `S03_C03_ELECTRICAL_INTERFACE`**
- Reveal: P→Tₑ electrical supply arrow plus separate textual note that EV charging load changes Power-system loading
- Why: Identify electrical power transfer and loading influence; do not draw unsupported reverse energy-transfer or thermal-causality arrows.
- Status: SOURCE-BACKED GENERAL RELATION; CASE THERMAL EFFECT OPEN; source basis: Qian et al. (2015); thesis canonical scope


## Slide 4 — 2. Extreme-Heat Research Context (REQUIRED; enabled)

Scientific guardrail: Never connect P and Tₑ with a thermal arrow on this slide. The two heat-to-capability lanes are separate.

**Click 1 — `S04_C01_EXTERNAL_HEAT`**
- Reveal: External extreme-heat forcing node above/outside both systems
- Why: Extreme heat is external forcing, not an internal equipment state.
- Status: THESIS-DEFINED; source basis: Canonical State-Time Definitions V1

**Click 2 — `S04_C02_P_HEAT_LANE`**
- Reveal: Downward forcing arrow; P thermal physical state; separately labeled capability/constraint node
- Why: Show the possible Power-system response to ambient/loading conditions without adding a Tₑ effect.
- Status: GENERAL SOURCE BACKED; CASE-SPECIFIC LAW OPEN; source basis: IEEE Std C57.91-2025; Thermal Scope V1

**Click 3 — `S04_C03_TE_HEAT_LANE`**
- Reveal: Second downward forcing arrow; Tₑ thermal physical state; separately labeled capability/constraint
- Why: Show independent charger/vehicle thermal response; no cross-system arrow.
- Status: EQUIPMENT-SPECIFIC PRIOR EVIDENCE; CASE OPEN; source basis: Krama et al. (2026); Thermal Scope V1

**Click 4 — `S04_C04_INFERENCE_LIMIT`**
- Reveal: Interpretive statement inside figure: Shared exposure ≠ directional thermal dependence
- Why: Contrast common forcing with independently evidenced physical coupling.
- Status: THESIS-DEFINED INFERENCE RULE; source basis: Canonical Thermal Interdependency Scope V1


## Slide 5 — 3. Research Problem (REQUIRED; enabled)

Scientific guardrail: Both paths are candidate causal chains. No confirmed bidirectionality, equipment limits, propagation delays, or actual service losses.

**Click 1 — `S05_C01_P_TO_TE_CANDIDATE`**
- Reveal: Candidate P→Tₑ lane: P thermal state; thermally conditioned Power limit; measured/operated electrical interface; charging capability; separate service consequence
- Why: Trace the source→constraint→interface→receiver and separate permitted capability from observed service.
- Status: CANDIDATE / CASE EVIDENCE OPEN; source basis: Canonical Thermal Interdependency Scope V1

**Click 2 — `S05_C02_P_TO_TE_GATE`**
- Reveal: P→Tₑ evidence gate: source thermal measurement + operating/protection law + interface delivery + receiver/service observations
- Why: Show precisely what data must justify the first direction before qualification.
- Status: CASE EVIDENCE OPEN; source basis: Canonical Evidence and Non-Invention Standard V1

**Click 3 — `S05_C03_TE_TO_P_CANDIDATE`**
- Reveal: Candidate Tₑ→P lane: Tₑ heat-conditioned control/limit; change at GRID-SIDE AC input; Power load/thermal response
- Why: Avoid inferring AC-side behavior from DC output or confusing reverse influence with reverse power flow.
- Status: CANDIDATE / CASE EVIDENCE OPEN; source basis: Canonical Thermal Interdependency Scope V1

**Click 4 — `S05_C04_TE_TO_P_GATE`**
- Reveal: Separate Tₑ→P evidence gate: measured AC current/power and grid-side P response; rival shared-heat explanation tested
- Why: Explain the independent qualification required for the second direction.
- Status: CASE EVIDENCE OPEN; source basis: Canonical Evidence and Non-Invention Standard V1
